## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I really wanted to try to make a drum machine, and found some tutorials and explanations online. It looked too complicated, though, and I decided to just make the starter project. Also, I had no idea

**7h**

I really wanted to try to make a drum machine, and found some tutorials and explanations online. It looked too complicated, though, and I decided to just make the starter project. Also, I had no idea how to design an instrument.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/c34e7abecec03940c150795247508fb75b54b7df7c8fe9d3741513d7ffe3ad90.png)

As soon as I saw the image on the guide, I didn't like that it had 7 keys. I wanted 8 keys so it looks like C, D, E, F, G, and the black keys in between.

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 152812](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/90ebc41711813806595504bc6db0ca134bf1a4ae3ea7eb49006a010c08992356.png)

The schematics were pretty simple. I didn't want to put the LEDs as the guide said, and it actually ended up working perfectly because my one extra key made up for the missing spot from the LEDs

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 152631](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/1b9604589174508c60bd4f5a75f4715655791b5536e221abe3f53407acd5c5fe.png)

I also had to use a 01x08 pin header instead of a 01x07, like the one in the guide.

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 152638](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/0f67c8717962879ed40c1f21219ef24e04c860ba74831238b7292da3566f0444.png)

I finished the whole schematics pretty soon, and it wasn't too complicated or anything.

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 152652](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/3b61a0bbb6b3ee07ac67c2590ab17a76d448617ea372292a653e7e9b6f5cf557.png)

Next, I added the footprints, which didn't take too long. After that, I had to create my own  footprint for the capacative touch keys.  For the next 2 hours, I tried to figure out how to make custom shapes like the piano keys. I watched many youtube videos, but they were all for KiCad 5, which had different settings.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/e1b4ce6575ea0704ed7d7f481f84a1de60e3eafc12c6e45f3f020491f1d22321.png)

Then I tried doing the Pad Graphic Editor, but that only added lines to the pad, and I couldn't figure out how to actually make solid shapes onto the pad.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/3ca5f030e239eaad2a5aebc8c54c9ac341673e5e014156325c0b577fe0b70dc9.png)

Finally, after getting very frustrated, I decided that I should just make rectangles.

![Screenshot 2026-10-25 100331](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/3dec38f9fa7a43e77d60a9b5162ab6c08e9d12170fc9d54ac49ce100776b0d86.png)

When I started placing the components onto the PCB, I became very grateful that I wasn't able to make custom shapes. It turned out that everything fit perfectly into the gaps between the "black" keys.

![Screenshot 2026-10-24 195529](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/810df651843b0ec6fcb776afa9d3d58001b7c4dad952ad48980e01c6534dccd3.png)

However, I had a very ugly ratsnest, so I had to rearrange some of the pins on the ESP32.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/29ae9232f64ee24e8bf8f4ca4eaa6b167898da8da61459b6f8188f182cdf0a1c.png)

It looks strange, but it's actually because I numbered my keys by size, not by position. After I did that, I wired the PCB, and it looks better with the new arrangement.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/278dfb1c876780bbe768e51b480a4ed1ac0fde32882e6ffaaeb8ed3a513b00c6.png)
